profile.headline: Software engineer, entrepreneur, artist, anatomy geek
profile.summary:
Embraces ownership – whether it’s a challenge, a mistake, or a success. Eager to collaborate on ideas.  Obsessed with efficiency. Refuses to be bored. 

Languages: JavaScript, Python, HTML, CSS, SQL
Frameworks & Libraries: TypeScript, React, Vue.js, Next.js, Node.js, Django
Tools & Platforms: Docker, AWS, Webpack, Turborepo, Heroku, Vercel
Databases: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL
Additional Skills: GraphQL, Gatsby, Sass, Tailwind, Kontent.ai

positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Full-time parenting
positions.description: Took time off to focus on having a healthy pregnancy, bonding with my baby and project building.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led front-end product features, implemented and maintained hundreds of UI components in Next.js, React, RTKQ, ZOD schema validation and Tailwind
-Collaborated cross-functionally with backend, UX research, design, and infrastructure (render stack) stakeholders to build scalable, user-friendly interfaces.
- Migrated 100+ components from Angular.js to Next.js with React and Tailwind, modernizing the tech stack and improving scalability.
- Enabled AI image generation into the product, allowing UX research teams to create realistic image variations for testing and user studies, accelerating experimentation and product insight gathering.
- Developed an Image Variation Playground to enable applying AI-driven image edits.
- Reduced marketing-related engineering requests by 90% by migrating the Imgix blog to a CMS-driven architecture using Kontentful.ai to automate JSON data parsing to MDN files for front-end styling.
- Implemented user/bug tracking with segment, axios
- Maintained PR testing/merging with Circle CI, and github actions
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Next.js · RTKQ

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
-Led workflow improvements by overhauling internal documentation, integrating automated support ticket plugins, and launching a
self-guided onboarding checklist — reducing team overhead and accelerating knowledge sharing.
-Mentored and onboarded 5+ engineers, cutting ramp-up time by 25% and improving support response times by 1–2 days through better tooling and process alignment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Managed 750+ websites, resolving bugs, implementing feature requests, and proactively monitoring performance — directly improving product reliability, user experience, and key engagement metrics.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Maintain, update, and build new features for growing startup providing kids yoga instructor certification, and classes.
- Reduced error-prone behavior by 50%, increasing platform stability and improving overall user satisfaction.
- Enabled a staging environment to support safer, more reliable releases and reduce production risk.
- Designed and implemented new user-facing pages, including database search, filtering, and result display via user-friendly info cards — driving a 100% increase in online engagement.
positions.insights: Skills: Apollo GraphQL · Ionos · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kontent · Customer Support

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained 20+ Python web scrapers using Scrapy, automating 90% of weekly data collection and significantly reducing
manual workload.
-Integrated scrapers with cloud storage and scaled the supporting database to handle increasing data volume and ensure long-term reliability.
-Enhanced research dashboard efficiency by implementing filter, search, and save functionality — improving user navigation and accelerating data access across teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Scrapy Framework · Django REST Framework · PostgreSQL · Selenium
